about_the_game:
Step into a fast-paced PvP combat game that blends intense battles across various arenas and battlegrounds. Experience a unique combat system and feel clutch movements in a never-seen-before combinaison of aerial prowesses and ground abilities. Visit vibrant social hubs to meet with other players, craft powerful equipments, customize your build and queue up for your next match to climb through the ranks!

Join the Okubi Community!

Okubi is being developed by a passionate solo-dev.  Join our growing community where development is open, collaborative, and shaped by the community. Frequent playtests are organized, and your feedback is welcome! Come test, share, and help shape the future of Okubi!

This pre-alpha demo offers a playable preview of Okubi's unique arena experience, featuring core combat systems and the immersive social hub. Compete in fast-paced matches, customize your build, and get a first look at the game's strategic depth.

What’s Included in the Demo:

  • Introduction Map

  • Access to PvP Arenas: 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3

  • A fully explorable Social Hub where you can meet other players and customize your loadout

  • Limited Crafting

  • Core Combat Preview: Experience aerial movement, grounded abilities, and skill-based gameplay

  • Limited build Customization: Modify loadouts and elemental attunements

  • Chat system

  • Limited NPC shops

What to Expect in the Full Game:

  • Additional battlegrounds modes

  • Access to a fully explorable small-scale PvPvE open world

  • Procedural events triggered by Yōkai with unpredictable effects on the battleground

  • A deeper ranking system with rewards and seasonal progression

  • Planetory Ressource Management with daily rewards

  • Player-Driven Economy and Auction House

  • Expanded items collection, customization, weapons, and social features

  • Additional playable classes

  • Additional NPC Shops

  • Caravan system in the open world

  • Expanded crafting and upgrades

  • Explorable bar with mini-games


    Please Note: This demo is an early version and may contain bugs or unfinished features. Your feedback helps improve the final game.

More...

Join this journey where development is open, collaborative, and shaped by the community. Frequent playtests are organized, and your feedback is welcome—it helps drive real change. Come test, share, and help shape the future of Okubi!

GAMEPLAY, FEATURES AND MECHANICS!                                                                           

HIGH-SKILL-CAP AERIAL AND GROUND COMBAT

Step into OKUBI’s distinct combat experience, combining fluid aerial maneuvers with powerful ground techniques for a thrilling, responsive feel. Easy to learn, hard to master.

REWARDING ARENAS AND BATTLEGROUNDS

Step into the arena! Engage in intense 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and various team-based battlegrounds. Slay enemy players or complete challenges to claim mythic rewards! Ascend through ranked tiers and become the undisputed champion.

IMMERSIVE SOCIAL HUB EXPERIENCE

Meet other players in the Public Hub where you can hang out, craft powerful equipment, customize your build and train before you queue up for your next match. Find the portal to join a real-time open world.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

Build and upgrade your character to adapt it's combat skills to your playstyle. Customize your weapons with dynamic buffs, adding unique trigger effects that enhance your character and increase strategic depth in combat.

ELEMENTAL ATTUNEMENTS

Harness the power of the 5 Elements to define your combat style. Infuse your weapons with unique effects and unleash devastating abilities, turning every encounter into a test of skill and strategy.

PROCEDURAL EVENTS

Experience dynamic gameplay in Okubi as the mysterious Yōkai can spawn unpredictable events directly onto the battlefield, keeping you on your toes and adding an element of surprise to each match!

content_descriptors.notes: OKUBI contains combat with mild blood effects, intense action, and occasional mature language. Characters may shout or taunt during battle with light profanity. While the game doesn’t include sexual content, players should expect fast-paced fights, violent impacts, and a gritty tone that may not be suitable for younger audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 SP1+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 1700X Eight-Core, 3400 Mhz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ASIO-compatible or high-definition sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ASIO-compatible or high-definition sound card

short_description: OKUBI is a fast-paced PvP combat game where brutal melee combos collides with adrenaline-fueled aerial battles. Deploy your wings and experience razor-sharp control and unmatched freedom of movements in various battlegrounds and arenas.
